name: Halloween Night Incubus
original_name: ハロウィンナイトインキュバス
source:
Incubus Latroquel was born and never went to the human world.

Tonight is October 31st. It's Halloween.

Today, when the magical power of the devil is increasing, I am enthusiastic to go to the human world and have sex with a woman, but I am disturbed by my childhood friend Liatris ...! ??

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26792]Freem[/url]]
translation:
梦魇拉特罗奎尔出生后从未到过人类世界。

今晚是10月31日。今天是万圣节。

在恶魔魔力增强的今天，我热衷于前往人间与女人发生性关系，却被青梅竹马的莉亚特莉丝打扰了……！??
